fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-09-16, around 16:40, the complainant lost a gold chain of about 4 sovereigns near Mynthan Colony Main Street in Erode when a rider on a white scooter bearing registration number TN-58-YY-1085 grabbed it and sped away, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-09-16. The online submission was made by Harini Sri (9000000444). The complaint mentions Vignesh Natarajan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000177, in connection with the events. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Rider reportedly approached from behind, grabbed the chain and fled.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, two-wheeler, mobile number, suspect, scooter, afternoon, main street
